🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B

📍 2. moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro

🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro

🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/FusionCow/Sulphur-3
